correctness.rationale: Exact character-root fibers multiply as H_{c_j}(m), since idempotents retract each rooted basin onto an arbitrarily chosen nonempty subset of its fixed block. Uniform Laplace estimates with explicit lower and upper tails prove log H_c(m)=cm(log m-log log m+log c-1)+o(m) and image size c m/log m in probability. Convexity of sum c_j log c_j strictly selects (r-1,1) among nonconstant fixed-root partitions with multiplicity r(r-1) for r>=3 and 1 for r=2. The resulting exponentially rare probability and rank law follow for every fixed r>=2. Direct full-map enumeration independently verified ten small parameter pairs; it is not used as proof of the infinite limit.

value.rationale: The natural uniform distribution on idempotent endomorphisms of r equal blocks exhibits a nonobvious global collapse phenomenon rather than typical preservation of individual blocks. The fixed-r law answers quantitatively how fast noncollapsed characters vanish, determines the universal dominant two-root exceptional geometry and the logarithmic growth of the actual image. It gives an infinite-family structural distributional classification that goes substantially beyond finite counting tables or routine substitutions.
